title: The Night Watch and the scary dream.
lines: When all the children are asleep, the city goes quiet.
But in the night three children are awake.
She has a sword of light.
Lewis is a bit scared, but very clever.
And Jens is funny, and he has a special shield.
When they go to work, they say a spell.
And then they're in the dream world.
In the dream world anything is possible.
But in the dream world there are also naughty creatures.
They turn nice dreams into nightmares.
They scare children in their sleep.
One night the Night Watch gets a message.
A little girl, Lotte, is having a bad dream.
She's dreaming of a dark forest.
The Night Watch jumps into her dream.
Lotte is sitting under a tree.
Two red eyes are looking out from between the trees.
A big shadow monster comes closer.
Xena says: It's okay to be scared.
Monsters in dreams get bigger when you're scared.
They have to make Lotte laugh.
He trips and falls on his bottom.
She sees Jens with a branch on his head.
It gets as small as a mouse.
And then as small as an ant.
It becomes a happy fairy-tale forest.
Lotte dances with the Night Watch among the flowers.
The Night Watch goes back home.
Lotte wakes up in her bed.
I had such a lovely dream, she tells her mummy.
